case_unit: Specific dated decision object/component within actual case; options, disposition, implementation and benefit separate
decision_vocabulary_basis: ExistingQ007, source wording retained and analystnormalisation bounded; not every public case supplies a disposition

matrix_rows.context: Retained arrangement on merit or mixed grounds
matrix_rows.establish: The specific option, alternatives and unaided reason; a survey no-change/satisfied answer is not an inspected renewal.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Confirm fit and relevant performance; retain feasible process/control/capability improvements where needed.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Retention is not automatically inertia, absence of unmet needs or no investment.

matrix_rows.establish: Actual deadline/obligation, feasible replacement/transition, scope and next review if known.
matrix_rows.possible_response: A proportionate continuation, staged preparation or improved incumbent may be considered; record actual action separately.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Do not infer permanent lock-in, irrationality, hidden satisfaction or guaranteed later replacement.

matrix_rows.context: Change selected/approved or operational change reported
matrix_rows.establish: Exact product/service/task/counterparty/organisation object; authority/commitment and current delivery.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Match support and evidence to the actual changed component, retained work and handover.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Approval is not signature/go-live; operational processing is not quantified/causal benefit.

matrix_rows.establish: Whether the proposal decision or only release date is deferred; remaining condition, owner, date/review and subsequent events.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Target the stated condition if addressable, or respect timing; keep actual action and effect separate.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Pending is not an assumed state from silence; postponed implementation is not automatically deferred approval or abandonment.

matrix_rows.context: Proposal declined or one option rejected
matrix_rows.establish: Exact decision/object, stated grounds and alternatives selected; no inference that the underlying need vanished.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Revise scope/evidence only if appropriate and permitted, or accept a reasoned decline; remedy unvalidated until observed.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: No current private-employer decline rationale is established by this desktop case set.

matrix_rows.establish: What ceased, what continued, stage/date, remaining obligations and reason directly known.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Assess actual stop/handback/dependency and any supported alternative; a justified stop can remain valid.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Component cancellation is not whole-need abandonment, inevitable failure or proof an earlier stop would have been better.

matrix_rows.establish: Type/body of the notice, event date/reason, actual procurement/contract/need that the label refers to.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Seek authoritative clarification where available; preserve unknown future route.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: An advance-notice label does not prove a commenced tender, cancelled upgrade or lost buyer opportunity.

matrix_rows.context: Need not raised / no qualifying recent case
matrix_rows.establish: Existing Q006route: never-raised need, older context, uncertain eligibility and refusal remain separate.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Use only relevant optional clarification, honour refusal and return to existing guide route.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: No recalled case is not automatically organisational indecision; historical context does not fill recent sample.

matrix_rows.context: Unknown, not measured, not applicable or not disclosed
matrix_rows.establish: Which field is missing and whose knowledge supports what is known.
matrix_rows.possible_response: Preserve missingness; do not demand confidential budgets/contracts or complete histories.
matrix_rows.inference_limit: Missing information is not zero cost, no benefit, failure, pending approval or concealed reluctance.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Feasible options at the dated event
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Which alternatives were practically available then, what maintaining service required and which conditions would persist under another option.
cross_cutting_conditions.inference_limit: A later option set or result does not establish earlier irrationality. A new supplier does not automatically remove upstream data or organisational conditions.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Last evidenced state and observation boundary
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Last observed event/date, source publication/knowledge basis, forecast versus observed milestones and what later outcome remains unestablished.
cross_cutting_conditions.inference_limit: An elapsed forecast date is not evidence of success, continued delay or abandonment. Repeated documents about one programme are not independent employers or a market trend.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Distinct lifecycle dates and usable receiving arrangement
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Product/service, processing/support eligibility, commitments, access/export, receiving setup and first live run, with the relevant owner/date only where material.
cross_cutting_conditions.inference_limit: Same supplier is not necessarily same product; read-only access is not supported processing or a proven secure permanent archive; declared export is not verified receiving-service readiness.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Other-party commitment and continuing knowledge
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: For a relevant talent option: employer approval/offer, the candidate or other party’s actual agreement/start, handover and continuing receiving-team knowledge/ownership.
cross_cutting_conditions.inference_limit: Approval to recruit, verbal acceptance, start and useful enduring capability are different events. No current candidate availability, universal interim duration or hiring necessity follows.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Completion for the affected user and task
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Relevant user/cohort, current task and needed historical evidence, supported channel and receiving service/help owner after change or retirement.
cross_cutting_conditions.inference_limit: Contractual exit or a new portal alone does not establish usable access, harm-free transition or satisfied needs. No mandatory new user interviews, unlimited archive or legal retention rule introduced.

second_challenge_contexts.name: London Fire Brigade dated authorisation/reset history

second_challenge_specific_exclusions: No expired target treated as actual later success, delay or abandonment
No public programme history or supplier declaration as market prevalence
No supplier retirement implies mandatory purchase of that supplier replacement
No read-only/export guarantee as tested secure usable handback
No candidate offer/acceptance/start or knowledge-transfer advice as observed capability
No recruitment premise from constructed prompts as actual demand or barrier evidence
No government retirement/redirect timings or legal archive/retention obligation transferred
Screened Cambridge general payslip declaration excluded from claims; no old tax/security advice adopted
second_challenge_review_basis: Scoped peer review of other strands/integration plus root verification of separately authored competitor sources and exact bridge; not fully independent integrated audit
